newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-TEENAGER HINGIS SHOWS COMPOSURE BEYOND HER YEARS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-TEENAGER HINGIS SHOWS COMPOSURE BEYOND HER YEARS.

text.p: Swiss Martina Hingis showed composure beyond her 16 years on Saturday, to reach the final of the Filderstadt women's tournament with a three-set victory over Olympic champion Lindsay Davenport.
Despite losing the first set of the semifinal as she sought to cope with the American fourth seed's power, Hingis kept her cool to clinch the next two sets for a 3-6 6-2 6-3 victory in 92 minutes.

Hingis beat Spanish top seed Arantxa Sanchez Vicario in Friday's quarter-finals and has been enjoying a superb run of form on the circuit in the second half of the year. She is now ranked 10th in the world.
Davenport eventually lost her nerve after the Hingis comeback. At 5-3 down, she netted a backhand to face match point and then hit the ball past the baseline to give Hingis the match.
"She played the game very quickly in the first set. I was under a lot of pressure and she attacked all the time," said Hingis, seeded eight.
"I knew that I had to keep going because I had the better fitness. I made sure the rallies were long. Things are going really well in the second half of the year."
In Sunday's final Hingis will meet the winner of Saturday's second semifinal between German fifth seed Anke Huber and Austrian Judith Wiesner.
